name: Arrugas Faciales
description: Analiza arrugas faciales para detectar inconsistencias de deepfake
algorithm: Facial Wrinkle Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial wrinkle patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Wrinkle Detección & Clasificación**: Wrinkles are detected using multi-scale ridge detection and classified by type: dynamic wrinkles (appear during expressions — forehead furrows, crow's feet), static wrinkles (always present — nasolabial folds), and fine lines (aging-related texture). Each wrinkle's depth, length, and position are measured.

2. **Expression - Wrinkle Correlación**: Dynamic wrinkles must correlate with facial expressions — forehead wrinkles with brow raise (AU1/AU2), crow's feet with cheek raise (AU6), nasolabial deepening with smile (AU12). The method verifies these anatomical correlations. Deepfakes may produce expressions without corresponding wrinkles or wrinkles without corresponding expressions.

3. **Wrinkle Position Estabilidad**: Static wrinkles occupy fixed positions determined by skin's collagen structure. The method tracks wrinkle positions across frames — wrinkle locations should remain stable (may vary in visibility with expression but not in position). Temporal wrinkle position drift indicates AI generation.

4. **Wrinkle Rendering Quality**: Wrinkles have specific rendering characteristics: they are valleys in the skin surface creating linear shadows with depth-dependent width. The method evaluates wrinkle rendering quality — AI generators often produce wrinkles that are too sharp (drawn lines) or too diffuse (lacking proper 3D depth cues).

5. **Age - Appropriate Wrinkle Mapeo**: The wrinkle pattern should be age-appropriate: young faces have few static wrinkles, aged faces show predictable wrinkle progression (forehead → crow's feet → nasolabial → marionette). The method checks wrinkle pattern consistency with apparent age. Face-swapped deepfakes may show wrinkle-age mismatches.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante facial wrinkle consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
